comparison.objective: Position a magnifying glass relative to a wrist camera to inspect fine detail; candidate breaks and recovers four insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Inspection task tests unsupported tool grasp, optical pose control, and visual readability; candidate tests contact tooling, bimanual hammering, lateral-force control, and fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Scoring requires measured enlargement, newly readable bars, and a three-second unsupported handle grasp; candidate requires four physical fractures, no damage, complete tang containment, and two-second stability.
comparison.reason: Optical inspection and view manipulation test a different ability and outcome from physical fracture and recovery.
